payload.question: Which states lead in transforming PACS into Multi-Service Entities?
payload.sql: WITH pacs_services AS (SELECT m.state_name, (CAST(COALESCE(p.pesticide_distribution, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.fertilizer_distribution, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.seed_distribution, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_foodgrains, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.agricultural_implements, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.dry_storage, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.cold_storage, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_lgs_program, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.milk_unit, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.food_processing, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_csc, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_fpo, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_lpg_distributership, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_bcp_pump, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_dpp_diesel, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_pm_kusum_scheme, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.fair_price, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_jak, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_paani_samity, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_consumer_business, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_tourism, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_cash_kendra_facilities, '0') AS INTEGER)) AS service_count FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master m JOIN chatbot_cooperative_pacs p ON m.cooperative_id = p.ncd_id WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.is_draft = 0 AND m.is_approved = 1 AND m.is_multi_state = 0 AND m.primary_activity_name ILIKE '%PACS%') SELECT state_name AS state, COUNT(*) AS total_pacs, SUM(CASE WHEN service_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mse_pacs_count, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN service_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2) AS transformation_percentage FROM pacs_services GROUP BY state_name ORDER BY mse_pacs_count DESC, transformation_percentage DESC;

payload.question: Show me YoY growth by cooperative sector
payload.sql: WITH sector_yearly_stats AS (SELECT primary_activity_name AS sector, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS registrations FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND state_name ILIKE 'GUJARAT' AND date_registration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2), growth_calculation AS (SELECT sector, reg_year, registrations, LAG(registrations) OVER (PARTITION BY sector ORDER BY reg_year) AS previous_year_registrations FROM sector_yearly_stats) SELECT sector, reg_year, registrations AS current_registrations, previous_year_registrations, ROUND(((registrations - previous_year_registrations)::numeric / NULLIF(previous_year_registrations, 0)) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_percent FROM growth_calculation WHERE previous_year_registrations IS NOT NULL AND registrations > 5 ORDER BY yoy_growth_percent DESC, reg_year DESC LIMIT 10;

payload.question: 5-year YoY cooperative sector growth trend broken down by state
payload.sql: WITH state_yearly_stats AS (SELECT LOWER(state_name) AS normalized_state_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS registrations FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration IS NOT NULL AND date_registration >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 years') GROUP BY LOWER(state_name), reg_year), growth_comparison AS (SELECT normalized_state_name, reg_year, registrations, LAG(registrations) OVER (PARTITION BY normalized_state_name ORDER BY reg_year) AS prev_registrations FROM state_yearly_stats) SELECT normalized_state_name AS state, reg_year AS year, registrations AS new_societies_registered, prev_registrations, ROUND(((registrations - prev_registrations)::numeric / NULLIF(prev_registrations, 0)) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_percent FROM growth_comparison WHERE prev_registrations IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year DESC, yoy_growth_percent DESC;

payload.question: Top states by PACS diversification into multi-service entities
payload.sql: WITH pacs_services AS (SELECT m.state_name, (CAST(COALESCE(p.pesticide_distribution, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.fertilizer_distribution, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.seed_distribution, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_foodgrains, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.agricultural_implements, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.dry_storage, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.cold_storage, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_lgs_program, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.milk_unit, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.food_processing, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_csc, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_fpo, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_lpg_distributership, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_bcp_pump, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_dpp_diesel, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_pm_kusum_scheme, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.fair_price, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_jak, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_paani_samity, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_consumer_business, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_tourism, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_cash_kendra_facilities, '0') AS INTEGER)) AS service_count FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master m JOIN chatbot_cooperative_pacs p ON m.cooperative_id = p.ncd_id WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.is_draft = 0 AND m.is_approved = 1 AND m.is_multi_state = 0 AND m.primary_activity_name ILIKE '%PACS%') SELECT state_name AS state, COUNT(*) AS total_pacs, SUM(CASE WHEN service_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mse_pacs_count, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN service_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2) AS transformation_percentage FROM pacs_services GROUP BY state_name ORDER BY mse_pacs_count DESC, transformation_percentage DESC;

payload.question: 10-year growth analysis of cooperative societies in India
payload.sql: WITH yearly_stats AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS new_societies FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration IS NOT NULL AND date_registration >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10 years') GROUP BY reg_year), growth_comparison AS (SELECT reg_year, new_societies, LAG(new_societies) OVER (ORDER BY reg_year) AS prev_year_new_societies FROM yearly_stats) SELECT reg_year AS year, new_societies AS total_registrations, prev_year_new_societies AS registrations_prev_year, ROUND(((new_societies - prev_year_new_societies)::numeric / NULLIF(prev_year_new_societies, 0)) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate_percent FROM growth_comparison ORDER BY year DESC;

payload.question: Year-on-year growth of cooperative registrations in the last 10 years
payload.sql: WITH yearly_stats AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS new_societies FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration IS NOT NULL AND date_registration >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10 years') GROUP BY reg_year), growth_comparison AS (SELECT reg_year, new_societies, LAG(new_societies) OVER (ORDER BY reg_year) AS prev_year_new_societies FROM yearly_stats) SELECT reg_year AS year, new_societies AS total_registrations, prev_year_new_societies AS registrations_prev_year, ROUND(((new_societies - prev_year_new_societies)::numeric / NULLIF(prev_year_new_societies, 0)) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate_percent FROM growth_comparison ORDER BY year DESC;

payload.question: Fastest growing cooperative activity types year over year
payload.sql: WITH sector_yearly_stats AS (SELECT primary_activity_name AS sector, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS registrations FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND state_name ILIKE 'GUJARAT' AND date_registration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2), growth_calculation AS (SELECT sector, reg_year, registrations, LAG(registrations) OVER (PARTITION BY sector ORDER BY reg_year) AS previous_year_registrations FROM sector_yearly_stats) SELECT sector, reg_year, registrations AS current_registrations, previous_year_registrations, ROUND(((registrations - previous_year_registrations)::numeric / NULLIF(previous_year_registrations, 0)) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_percent FROM growth_calculation WHERE previous_year_registrations IS NOT NULL AND registrations > 5 ORDER BY yoy_growth_percent DESC, reg_year DESC LIMIT 10;

payload.question: How has the cooperative movement in India grown in the last 10 years?
payload.sql: WITH yearly_stats AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS new_societies FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration IS NOT NULL AND date_registration >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10 years') GROUP BY reg_year), growth_comparison AS (SELECT reg_year, new_societies, LAG(new_societies) OVER (ORDER BY reg_year) AS prev_year_new_societies FROM yearly_stats) SELECT reg_year AS year, new_societies AS total_registrations, prev_year_new_societies AS registrations_prev_year, ROUND(((new_societies - prev_year_new_societies)::numeric / NULLIF(prev_year_new_societies, 0)) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate_percent FROM growth_comparison ORDER BY year DESC;

payload.question: Show me the overall growth rate of the cooperative movement in India over the last decade.

payload.question: Which states grew the most in cooperative registrations in last 5 years?
payload.sql: WITH state_yearly_stats AS (SELECT LOWER(state_name) AS normalized_state_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS registrations FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration IS NOT NULL AND date_registration >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 years') GROUP BY LOWER(state_name), reg_year), growth_comparison AS (SELECT normalized_state_name, reg_year, registrations, LAG(registrations) OVER (PARTITION BY normalized_state_name ORDER BY reg_year) AS prev_registrations FROM state_yearly_stats) SELECT normalized_state_name AS state, reg_year AS year, registrations AS new_societies_registered, prev_registrations, ROUND(((registrations - prev_registrations)::numeric / NULLIF(prev_registrations, 0)) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_percent FROM growth_comparison WHERE prev_registrations IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year DESC, yoy_growth_percent DESC;

payload.question: Compare the cooperative sector growth across all states year-on-year for the last 5 years.
payload.sql: WITH state_yearly_stats AS (SELECT LOWER(state_name) AS normalized_state_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS registrations FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration IS NOT NULL AND date_registration >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 years') GROUP BY LOWER(state_name), reg_year), growth_comparison AS (SELECT normalized_state_name, reg_year, registrations, LAG(registrations) OVER (PARTITION BY normalized_state_name ORDER BY reg_year) AS prev_registrations FROM state_yearly_stats) SELECT normalized_state_name AS state, reg_year AS year, registrations AS new_societies_registered, prev_registrations, ROUND(((registrations - prev_registrations)::numeric / NULLIF(prev_registrations, 0)) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_percent FROM growth_comparison WHERE prev_registrations IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year DESC, yoy_growth_percent DESC;

payload.question: Which sectors in the cooperative movement are growing the most?
payload.sql: WITH sector_yearly_stats AS (SELECT primary_activity_name AS sector, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS registrations FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND state_name ILIKE 'GUJARAT' AND date_registration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2), growth_calculation AS (SELECT sector, reg_year, registrations, LAG(registrations) OVER (PARTITION BY sector ORDER BY reg_year) AS previous_year_registrations FROM sector_yearly_stats) SELECT sector, reg_year, registrations AS current_registrations, previous_year_registrations, ROUND(((registrations - previous_year_registrations)::numeric / NULLIF(previous_year_registrations, 0)) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_percent FROM growth_calculation WHERE previous_year_registrations IS NOT NULL AND registrations > 5 ORDER BY yoy_growth_percent DESC, reg_year DESC LIMIT 10;

payload.question: Compare states on percentage of PACS becoming multi-service entities
payload.sql: WITH pacs_services AS (SELECT m.state_name, (CAST(COALESCE(p.pesticide_distribution, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.fertilizer_distribution, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.seed_distribution, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_foodgrains, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.agricultural_implements, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.dry_storage, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.cold_storage, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_lgs_program, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.milk_unit, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.food_processing, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_csc, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_fpo, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_lpg_distributership, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_bcp_pump, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_dpp_diesel, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_pm_kusum_scheme, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.fair_price, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_jak, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_paani_samity, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_consumer_business, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_tourism, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_cash_kendra_facilities, '0') AS INTEGER)) AS service_count FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master m JOIN chatbot_cooperative_pacs p ON m.cooperative_id = p.ncd_id WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.is_draft = 0 AND m.is_approved = 1 AND m.is_multi_state = 0 AND m.primary_activity_name ILIKE '%PACS%') SELECT state_name AS state, COUNT(*) AS total_pacs, SUM(CASE WHEN service_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mse_pacs_count, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN service_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2) AS transformation_percentage FROM pacs_services GROUP BY state_name ORDER BY mse_pacs_count DESC, transformation_percentage DESC;

payload.question: Annual cooperative growth comparison across all states for 5 years
payload.sql: WITH state_yearly_stats AS (SELECT LOWER(state_name) AS normalized_state_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS registrations FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration IS NOT NULL AND date_registration >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 years') GROUP BY LOWER(state_name), reg_year), growth_comparison AS (SELECT normalized_state_name, reg_year, registrations, LAG(registrations) OVER (PARTITION BY normalized_state_name ORDER BY reg_year) AS prev_registrations FROM state_yearly_stats) SELECT normalized_state_name AS state, reg_year AS year, registrations AS new_societies_registered, prev_registrations, ROUND(((registrations - prev_registrations)::numeric / NULLIF(prev_registrations, 0)) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_percent FROM growth_comparison WHERE prev_registrations IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year DESC, yoy_growth_percent DESC;

payload.question: Cooperative society growth trend over the past decade
payload.sql: WITH yearly_stats AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS new_societies FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration IS NOT NULL AND date_registration >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '10 years') GROUP BY reg_year), growth_comparison AS (SELECT reg_year, new_societies, LAG(new_societies) OVER (ORDER BY reg_year) AS prev_year_new_societies FROM yearly_stats) SELECT reg_year AS year, new_societies AS total_registrations, prev_year_new_societies AS registrations_prev_year, ROUND(((new_societies - prev_year_new_societies)::numeric / NULLIF(prev_year_new_societies, 0)) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate_percent FROM growth_comparison ORDER BY year DESC;

payload.question: State-wise ranking of PACS to MSE transformation
payload.sql: WITH pacs_services AS (SELECT m.state_name, (CAST(COALESCE(p.pesticide_distribution, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.fertilizer_distribution, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.seed_distribution, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_foodgrains, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.agricultural_implements, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.dry_storage, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.cold_storage, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_lgs_program, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.milk_unit, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.food_processing, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_csc, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_fpo, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_lpg_distributership, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_bcp_pump, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_dpp_diesel, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_pm_kusum_scheme, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.fair_price, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_jak, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_paani_samity, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_consumer_business, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_tourism, '0') AS INTEGER) + CAST(COALESCE(p.is_cash_kendra_facilities, '0') AS INTEGER)) AS service_count FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master m JOIN chatbot_cooperative_pacs p ON m.cooperative_id = p.ncd_id WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.is_draft = 0 AND m.is_approved = 1 AND m.is_multi_state = 0 AND m.primary_activity_name ILIKE '%PACS%') SELECT state_name AS state, COUNT(*) AS total_pacs, SUM(CASE WHEN service_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mse_pacs_count, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN service_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2) AS transformation_percentage FROM pacs_services GROUP BY state_name ORDER BY mse_pacs_count DESC, transformation_percentage DESC;

payload.question: Which cooperative sectors are growing fastest year-on-year?

payload.question: Show cooperative registration growth by state over the past 5 years
payload.sql: WITH state_yearly_stats AS (SELECT LOWER(state_name) AS normalized_state_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) AS reg_year, COUNT(*) AS registrations FROM chatbot_cooperative_registrations_master WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration IS NOT NULL AND date_registration >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 years') GROUP BY LOWER(state_name), reg_year), growth_comparison AS (SELECT normalized_state_name, reg_year, registrations, LAG(registrations) OVER (PARTITION BY normalized_state_name ORDER BY reg_year) AS prev_registrations FROM state_yearly_stats) SELECT normalized_state_name AS state, reg_year AS year, registrations AS new_societies_registered, prev_registrations, ROUND(((registrations - prev_registrations)::numeric / NULLIF(prev_registrations, 0)) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_percent FROM growth_comparison WHERE prev_registrations IS NOT NULL ORDER BY year DESC, yoy_growth_percent DESC;
